title: Chapter 8: Home and the Undefeated Spirit
chineseTitle: 第 8 章：重返港湾与永不言败的灵魂（终极结局）

paragraphs.en: In the small hours before dawn, Santiago sailed his skiff into the quiet harbor. He tied the boat to a rock, looking back at the giant eighteen-foot fish skeleton bound to the skiff. Shouldering his mast, he climbed up to his shack and fell asleep on his bed.
paragraphs.zh: 在黎明前的丑时，圣地亚哥划着小船驶入了平静的港湾。他把船系在石头上，回头看着绑在小船上的十八英尺巨型鱼骨。扛着桅杆，他爬上他的小破棚并在床上睡着了。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, the boy came to the shack. Seeing the old man's bloody hands resting in sleep, the boy wept. Fishermen gathered in awe around the skeleton. The boy sat beside Santiago until he awoke, promising: 'We will fish together again.' Santiago smiled gently and closed his eyes to rest, dreaming of the lions.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早上，孩子来到了小破棚。看到老老人睡梦中沾满鲜血的双手，孩子哭了。渔夫们带着敬畏拥挤在骨架周围。孩子坐在圣地亚哥身边直到他醒来，承诺：“我们还要一起捕鱼。”圣地亚哥温柔地笑了笑，闭上双眼休息，梦见那些狮子。
